questions.title: Who will win the welterweight championship main event at UFC 330?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : UFC's official event results, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting. Resolution : Resolve to the fighter officially declared the winner of the welterweight championship main event at UFC 330. Use the result announced on fight night, excluding any subsequent reversal. Accepted Answer Format : The winning fighter's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Announced June 17 as the UFC 330 main event (Aug 15, Philadelphia), P4P No. 1 welterweight champion Islam Makhachev (28-1, 16-fight UFC win streak, defeated Jack Della Maddalena at UFC 322) makes his first 170-lb defense against No. 1 contender Ian Machado Garry (17-1, coming off wins over Carlos Prates and Belal Muhammad). Betting markets moved strongly toward Makhachev after opening, ranging from -290/+235 on DraftKings (~71.4% devigged) to -365/+300 on BetOnline (~75.8%) and -390/+300 on FanDuel (~76.1%). Adjusting for ~4% combined draw/no-contest and injury-replacement risk seven weeks out gives Makhachev 72% and Ian Machado Garry 24%.

local_articles.snippet: PHILADELPHIA – The UFC 330 event on Aug 15 is reaching a fever pitch in the welterweight division, as newly minted champion Islam Makhachev defends his crown against surging contender Ian Machado Garry in the night’s headliner at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia. The event marks the UFC’s first Philadelphia event in seven years, and the promotion’s last numbered event in the city was UFC 133 in August 2011. The verbal warfare ignited on Aug 13 during the pre-fight press conference in front of a raucous Philly crowd, where the two elite fighters traded heated barbs over Dagestani wrestling compared to Irish striking supremacy. While security was no issue during the traditional ceremonial faceoff, the electric tension between the champ and challenger served as the climax to a high-stakes fight week in the City of Brotherly Love.
